svg.title: webdevops image tags explained
svg.desc: Image tag anatomy using webdevops/php-nginx-dev:8.5-alpine as the example. Web server: php (PHP-FPM), php-apache (+ Apache) or php-nginx (+ Nginx). Variant: no suffix for production, -dev for development. PHP version: 8.2, 8.3, 8.4 or 8.5. Base OS: no suffix for Debian bookworm, -alpine for Alpine. Extends the official php images. linux/amd64 + linux/arm64. Rebuilt nightly.
